description.value:
You've dedicated much of your life to gaining a deeper understanding of a god or philosophy. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat for one Lore skill tied to a deity, faith, or philosophy of your choice, such as Oras Lore or Green Faith Lore. The religious symbol of this deity or philosophy is permanently marked onto your flesh, either as a birthmark, intentional pattern choice, or a devotional branding.

This religious symbol sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius around you (and dim light to the next 20 feet). You can extinguish or rekindle this light as a single action that has the concentrate trait.
